lines.text: Do you remember when you built this? Probably not.
Why on earth would I remember what I built? I mean, I know some keywords, but that's it.
He built it by talking to AI. A hundred and twenty chats. He remembers three keywords.
lines.caption: He built it by talking to AI. 120 chats. He remembers three keywords.

lines.text: I'm Mason. I live in his menu bar, and I was there.
While he works, I wait for a pause. Then I ask why.
Why this path, and not the other?
Every answer becomes a decision I keep, in his own words.
lines.say: [pause] Every answer becomes a decision I keep, in his own words.

lines.text: Then I call, and quiz him, until it sticks.
Tell me about the food app you built a month ago.
A month later, the same question.
lines.say: [pause] A month later, the same question.

lines.text: So, Gustaf. How did you build it?
Now he doesn't answer with three keywords. He answers with every decision, and why.
Mason. Learning by doing, without the forgetting.
